WITH city_attendance AS (
    SELECT 
        z.city,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) as member_count
    FROM attendance a
    JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
    JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
    GROUP BY z.city
),
totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(member_count) as total_members FROM city_attendance
),
shares_calculated AS (
    SELECT 
        c.city,
        c.member_count,
        CAST(c.member_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_members as share
    FROM city_attendance c
    CROSS JOIN totals t
),
avg_share_overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares_calculated
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        s.member_count,
        s.share,
        s.share - a.avg_share as above_avg
    FROM shares_calculated s
    CROSS JOIN avg_share_overall a
    WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
)
SELECT 
    AVG(member_count) as avg_count,
    AVG(share) as avg_share,
    AVG(above_avg) as avg_above_average
FROM filtered
